extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: wooden rowing boat (clinker built), approx. 3.6 x 1.45 x 0.9 m (L x W x H), oars 2.3 m
extras.notes: bow faces -Y; sits on its keel strip on z = 0, add your own water (waterline at 0.22 m: blue boot stripe above the antifouling); separate moving parts with origin in the oarlock: rowboat_oar_port, rowboat_oar_starboard (swing around Z, can also tilt); open hull with frames, three thwarts and floorboards; no brand, no text, no registration number

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
